text: Pinehurst now has two codebases that can each break production: the dbt project, and the Terraform repo provisioning the Snowflake warehouses and roles under it. This lesson gates both.
One pull request, two checks: dbt build and test run against a disposable per-PR schema, and Terraform runs fmt, validate, and plan. Both are required before main will accept a merge.
The dbt job never touches RAW or CURATED -- it builds and tests in its own CI schema, named for the pull request, then drops that schema when it finishes.
Terraform only ever plans in CI, using a read-only principal that can't change anything. Apply stays a deliberate step a person runs by hand, outside this workflow.
Both gates are proven live with a deliberately broken pull request. Next: building health checks for this pipeline once it's actually running.
